767	/-! ## Project-local Mathlib supplement — composite away-localisation (route B, change-of-ring)
768	
769	The route-B change-of-ring transfer (`lem:away_comparison_isLocalizedModule`, used by
770	`dDiff_exact_of_localizationAway`) needs the elementary fact that *localising twice*
771	— first `M ⇝ M_f` at `powers f`, then `M_f ⇝ N` at `powers (algebraMap R R_f a)` over the
772	localisation ring `R_f` — presents `N` as the single away localisation `M_a`, provided `f` is
773	already inverted once `a` is (`a^j = f·h`, i.e. `f ∈ √(a)`).  This is the module analogue of
774	`Localization.Away f` then `Localization.Away a = Localization.Away a` when `f ∣ aⁿ`. -/

776	namespace AwayComparison
777	
778	/-- **Composite of two away localisations is an away localisation.**  See the section
779	docstring.  The `R`-linear composite `gN ∘ mkf : M → N` exhibits `N` as `M` localised at
780	`Submonoid.powers a`, given `a^j = f * h` (so `f` divides a power of `a`). -/
781	lemma isLocalizedModule_comp_away
782	    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
783	    {Rf : Type u} [CommRing Rf] [Algebra R Rf]
784	    {Mf : Type u} [AddCommGroup Mf] [Module R Mf] [Module Rf Mf] [IsScalarTower R Rf Mf]
785	    {N : Type u} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [Module Rf N] [IsScalarTower R Rf N]
786	    (f a h : R) {j : ℕ} (hfa : a ^ j = f * h)
787	    (mkf : M →ₗ[R] Mf) [IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f) mkf]
788	    (gN : Mf →ₗ[Rf] N) [IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers (algebraMap R Rf a)) gN] :
789	    IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers a) ((gN.restrictScalars R) ∘ₗ mkf) := by
790	  have smulN : ∀ (r : R) (y : N), r • y = (algebraMap R Rf r) • y :=
791	    fun r y => (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul Rf r y).symm
792	  have smulMf : ∀ (r : R) (y : Mf), r • y = (algebraMap R Rf r) • y :=
793	    fun r y => (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul Rf r y).symm
794	  -- `a^j = f h` lifts to `a^{j n} = f^n h^n`
795	  have hfa' : ∀ n : ℕ, a ^ (j * n) = f ^ n * h ^ n := fun n => by
796	    rw [pow_mul, hfa, mul_pow]
797	  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
798	  · -- map_units: `a` acts invertibly on `N` (as `algebraMap R Rf a` does)
799	    rintro ⟨x, n, rfl⟩
800	    rw [Module.End.isUnit_iff]
801	    have hb : Function.Bijective
802	        (⇑(algebraMap Rf (Module.End Rf N) ((algebraMap R Rf a) ^ n))) :=
803	      (Module.End.isUnit_iff _).1 (by
804	        rw [map_pow]
805	        exact (IsLocalizedModule.map_units gN
806	          ⟨algebraMap R Rf a, Submonoid.mem_powers _⟩).pow n)
807	    have hfun : ⇑(algebraMap R (Module.End R N) (a ^ n))
808	        = ⇑(algebraMap Rf (Module.End Rf N) ((algebraMap R Rf a) ^ n)) := by
809	      funext y
810	      simp only [Module.algebraMap_end_eq_smul_id, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.id_apply]
811	      rw [smulN, map_pow]
812	    rw [hfun]; exact hb
813	  · -- surjectivity
814	    intro y
815	    obtain ⟨⟨mf, u⟩, hu⟩ := IsLocalizedModule.surj (Submonoid.powers (algebraMap R Rf a)) gN y
816	    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := u.2
817	    obtain ⟨⟨m0, v⟩, hv⟩ := IsLocalizedModule.surj (Submonoid.powers f) mkf mf
818	    obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := v.2
819	    simp only [] at hk hl
820	    rw [Submonoid.smul_def] at hu hv
821	    dsimp only at hu hv
822	    have hay : (a ^ k : R) • y = gN mf := by
823	      rw [smulN, map_pow, hk]; exact hu
824	    have hfm : (f ^ l : R) • mf = mkf m0 := by rw [hl]; exact hv
825	    refine ⟨⟨h ^ l • m0, ⟨a ^ (j * l + k), j * l + k, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩
826	    rw [Submonoid.smul_def]
827	    change (a ^ (j * l + k) : R) • y = gN (mkf (h ^ l • m0))
828	    have lhs : (a ^ (j * l + k) : R) • y = (f ^ l * h ^ l) • gN mf := by
829	      rw [pow_add, hfa' l, mul_smul, hay]
830	    have rhs : gN (mkf (h ^ l • m0)) = (h ^ l * f ^ l) • gN mf := by
831	      rw [_root_.map_smul, ← hfm, LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower,
832	        LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower, ← mul_smul]
833	    rw [lhs, rhs, mul_comm (f ^ l) (h ^ l)]
834	  · -- exists_of_eq
835	    intro x1 x2 hx
836	    simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, LinearMap.coe_restrictScalars, Function.comp_apply] at hx
837	    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := IsLocalizedModule.exists_of_eq
838	      (S := Submonoid.powers (algebraMap R Rf a)) (f := gN) hx
839	    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := u.2
840	    simp only [] at hk
841	    rw [Submonoid.smul_def] at hu
842	    have h1 : mkf ((a ^ k : R) • x1) = mkf ((a ^ k : R) • x2) := by
843	      rw [_root_.map_smul, _root_.map_smul]
844	      simp only [smulMf, map_pow, hk]
845	      exact hu
846	    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := IsLocalizedModule.exists_of_eq (S := Submonoid.powers f) (f := mkf) h1
847	    obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := w.2
848	    simp only [] at hl
849	    rw [Submonoid.smul_def] at hw
850	    have h2 : (f ^ l : R) • (a ^ k : R) • x1 = (f ^ l : R) • (a ^ k : R) • x2 := by
851	      rw [hl]; exact hw
852	    refine ⟨⟨a ^ (j * l + k), j * l + k, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
853	    rw [Submonoid.smul_def]
854	    change (a ^ (j * l + k) : R) • x1 = (a ^ (j * l + k) : R) • x2
855	    have hexp : a ^ (j * l + k) = h ^ l * (f ^ l * a ^ k) := by
856	      rw [pow_add, hfa' l]; ring
857	    simp only [hexp, mul_smul]
858	    rw [h2]
859

862	/-! ## Project-local Mathlib supplement — base-change composite localisation (route B1, change-of-ring)
863	
864	The general-affine-open seed (Stacks 02KG over an arbitrary affine `V = ⨆ᵢ D(gᵢ)`, NOT a single
865	`D(f)`) is proved by change of base to `S = Γ(V)`, where the cover family `ḡᵢ = algebraMap R S gᵢ`
866	DOES span the unit ideal.  The transport back to `R` needs, per Čech multi-index `σ`, the fact that
867	the composite `M → M ⊗_R S → (M ⊗_R S)_{ḡσ}` (base change to `S`, then localise at `ḡσ`) presents the
868	localised tensor as the localisation `M_{gσ}` of `M` at `powers gσ` over `R`.  This is the algebraic
869	analogue of `AwayComparison.isLocalizedModule_comp_away`, but with the FIRST leg a base change
870	(`IsBaseChange S`) rather than a localisation: `M → M_S` is not a localisation of `M` (S is not a
871	localisation of `R`).  The single geometric input — that the localised ring is simultaneously an
872	`R`-localisation at `powers gσ` — is supplied as the instance `[IsLocalization (powers a) Aloc]`. -/

874	/-- **Base-change composite is a localisation.**  Let `bc : M →ₗ[R] MS` exhibit `MS` as the base
875	change of `M` to an `R`-algebra `S` (`IsBaseChange S bc`), and let `gN : MS →ₗ[S] N` localise `MS`

877	`R`-localisation at `powers a` (the geometric input, encoding `D(a) ⊆ Spec S` when `S = Γ(V)`), then
878	the `R`-linear composite `gN ∘ bc : M →ₗ[R] N` exhibits `N` as the localisation of `M` at `powers a`.

881	`isLocalizedModule_iff_isBaseChange` converts both directions.  This is the route-B1 replacement for
882	`AwayComparison.isLocalizedModule_comp_away` in the general-affine `dDiff_exact_of_affineCover`. -/

884	    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]

886	    {MS : Type u} [AddCommGroup MS] [Module R MS] [Module S MS] [IsScalarTower R S MS]
887	    (bc : M →ₗ[R] MS) (hbc : IsBaseChange S bc)
888	    {a : R}
889	    {N : Type u} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [Module S N] [IsScalarTower R S N]
890	    (gN : MS →ₗ[S] N)
891	    (Aloc : Type u) [CommRing Aloc] [Algebra S Aloc]
892	    [IsLocalization (Submonoid.powers (algebraMap R S a)) Aloc]
893	    [Module Aloc N] [IsScalarTower S Aloc N]
894	    [IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers (algebraMap R S a)) gN]
895	    [Algebra R Aloc] [IsScalarTower R S Aloc] [IsScalarTower R Aloc N]
896	    [IsLocalization (Submonoid.powers a) Aloc] :
897	    IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers a) ((gN.restrictScalars R) ∘ₗ bc) := by

899	    (isLocalizedModule_iff_isBaseChange (Submonoid.powers (algebraMap R S a)) Aloc gN).mp
900	      inferInstance

906	`M = Γ(Spec R, F)` at the multi-index products `s_σ = ∏ₖ s_{σ k}`; its differential

306	/-- A **covering datum** on `X`: an index family of opens (the covered open is `⨆ i, c.2 i`).

308	(`cechCohomology`, `faceShortComplex`), which are indexed by a family `ι → Opens X`. -/

312	/-- **Cover system on a basis** (Stacks 01EO conditions (1)–(2)). Records a basis `B`, a set of
313	admissible coverings `Cov`, the faces-in-basis datum (every finite intersection of a covering's
314	opens lies in `B`, condition (1)), and the cofinality datum in the form it is consumed —
315	condition (2) packaged as the section-surjectivity it produces through `ses_cech_h1`: for every
316	short exact sequence `S` of `O_X`-modules whose left term has vanishing higher Čech cohomology,
317	the section map of `S.g` is surjective over every basic open. The auxiliary `injective_acyclic`
318	field records the standard-cover injective Čech-acyclicity (Stacks
319	`lemma-injective-trivial-cech`, i.e. `injective_cech_acyclic`) for the system's coverings.
320	Project-local: bespoke encoding; the two sheaf-theoretic fields are discharged at the affine
321	(02KG) instantiation by `ses_cech_h1` + standard-cover cofinality and by `injective_cech_acyclic`
322	respectively. -/
323	structure BasisCovSystem (X : Scheme.{u}) where
324	  /-- The basis of opens. -/
325	  B : Set (TopologicalSpace.Opens X)
326	  /-- The set of admissible coverings. -/
327	  Cov : Set (CovDatum X)
328	  /-- Condition (1): every finite intersection of a covering's opens lies in the basis. -/
329	  faces_mem : ∀ c ∈ Cov, ∀ (p : ℕ) (σ : Fin (p + 1) → c.1), (⨅ k, c.2 (σ k)) ∈ B
330	  /-- Condition (2), in the section-surjectivity shape produced by `ses_cech_h1` + cofinality. -/
331	  surj_of_vanishing : ∀ (S : ShortComplex X.Modules), S.ShortExact →
332	    (∀ c ∈ Cov, ∀ q, 0 < q →
333	      IsZero (cechCohomology c.2 ((Scheme.Modules.toPresheafOfModules X).obj S.X₁) q)) →
334	    ∀ V ∈ B, Function.Surjective (ConcreteCategory.hom
335	      (((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf X.ringCatSheaf.obj).map
336	        ((Scheme.Modules.toPresheafOfModules X).map S.g)).app (Opposite.op V)))
337	  /-- Injective Čech-acyclicity for the system's coverings (`injective_cech_acyclic`). -/
338	  injective_acyclic : ∀ (I : X.Modules), Injective I → ∀ c ∈ Cov, ∀ q, 0 < q →
339	    IsZero (cechCohomology c.2 ((Scheme.Modules.toPresheafOfModules X).obj I) q)

352	-- The dimension-shift induction embeds modules into injectives, which needs
353	-- `EnoughInjectives X.Modules`. That instance is NOT available in Mathlib for sheaves of modules
354	-- (it would follow from `IsGrothendieckAbelian (SheafOfModules R)`, which is absent — see
355	-- `analogies/p5a.md`), so — following the project convention for the P5a derived-functor lane —
356	-- it is carried as an explicit hypothesis on `injSES`/L4 rather than synthesized.

358	/-- The injective-embedding short exact sequence `0 → F → I → I/F → 0` of an `O_X`-module `F`,
359	with `I = Injective.under F` the chosen injective and `I/F` its cokernel. Project-local helper for
360	the 01EO dimension-shift induction; carries `[EnoughInjectives X.Modules]` as a hypothesis. -/
361	@[reducible] private noncomputable def injSES [EnoughInjectives X.Modules] (F : X.Modules) :
362	    ShortComplex X.Modules :=
363	  ShortComplex.mk (Injective.ι F) (cokernel.π (Injective.ι F)) (cokernel.condition _)

365	private lemma injSES_shortExact [EnoughInjectives X.Modules] (F : X.Modules) :
366	    (injSES F).ShortExact :=
367	  ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk (ShortComplex.exact_cokernel _)

369	/-- **Dimension-shift induction `Hᵖ(U, F) = 0` for `p > 0` (Stacks 01EO L4).** For a cover system
370	`s` on a basis and any `O_X`-module `F` with vanishing higher Čech cohomology for `s`, the
371	absolute cohomology `Hᵖ(U, F) = Extᵖ(jShriekOU U, F)` vanishes for every basic open `U ∈ s.B` and
372	`p > 0`. Induction on `p`, quantified over all `F` in the inductive class: the quotient
373	`Q = I/F` re-enters the class (via the section Čech SES of L1 from the per-face SES, plus L2
374	quotient-vanishing and the cover system's injective acyclicity), the base case is L3, and the
375	inductive step is the covariant Ext long exact sequence. Project-local: the 01EO inductive core. -/
376	theorem absoluteCohomology_eq_zero_of_basis [EnoughInjectives X.Modules] (s : BasisCovSystem X)
377	    {F : X.Modules} (hF : HasVanishingHigherCech s F)
378	    {U : TopologicalSpace.Opens X} (hU : U ∈ s.B) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p)
379	    (e : Ext (jShriekOU U) F p) : e = 0 := by
380	  have key : ∀ (n : ℕ) (F : X.Modules), HasVanishingHigherCech s F →
381	      ∀ (U : TopologicalSpace.Opens X), U ∈ s.B →
382	        ∀ e : Ext (jShriekOU U) F (n + 1), e = 0 := by
383	    intro n
384	    induction n with
385	    | zero =>
386	      intro F hF U hU e
387	      have hS := injSES_shortExact F
388	      haveI : Injective (injSES F).X₂ := inferInstance
389	      exact absoluteCohomology_one_eq_zero_of_basis U hS
390	        (s.surj_of_vanishing (injSES F) hS hF U hU) e
391	    | succ m ih =>
392	      intro F hF U hU e
393	      have hS := injSES_shortExact F
394	      haveI : Injective (injSES F).X₂ := inferInstance
395	      -- The quotient `Q = (injSES F).X₃` again has vanishing higher Čech cohomology.
396	      have hQ : HasVanishingHigherCech s (injSES F).X₃ := by
397	        intro c hc q hq
398	        set P := (injSES F).map (Scheme.Modules.toPresheafOfModules X) with hP
399	        have hface : ∀ (pp : ℕ) (σ : Fin (pp + 1) → c.1),
400	            (faceShortComplex c.2 P σ).ShortExact := by
401	          intro pp σ
402	          refine faceShortComplex_shortExact_of_sheaf_ses c.2 (injSES F) hS ?_ pp σ
403	          intro pp' σ'
404	          exact s.surj_of_vanishing (injSES F) hS hF _ (s.faces_mem c hc pp' σ')
405	        have hSES := cechComplex_shortExact_of_basis c.2 P hface
406	        exact quotient_cech_vanishing_of_basis c.2 P hSES
407	          (s.injective_acyclic (injSES F).X₂ inferInstance c hc) (hF c hc) q hq
408	      -- Ext long exact sequence step: `H^{m+2}(F)` is squeezed by `H^{m+1}(Q) = 0` (IH) and
409	      -- `H^{m+2}(I) = 0` (injective vanishing).
410	      have hef : e.comp (Ext.mk₀ (injSES F).f) (add_zero (m + 1 + 1)) = 0 :=
411	        absoluteCohomology_eq_zero_of_injective (m + 1) U (injSES F).X₂ _
412	      obtain ⟨x₃, hx₃⟩ :=
413	        absoluteCohomology_covariant_exact₁ U hS e hef (rfl : (m + 1) + 1 = m + 1 + 1)
414	      have hx₃zero : x₃ = 0 := ih (injSES F).X₃ hQ U hU x₃
415	      rw [← hx₃, hx₃zero, Ext.zero_comp]
416	  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hp.ne'
417	  exact key n F hF U hU e
